entries.en: You must talk to the Council to gain access to the Wards.
entries.tr: Wards'a girmek için Konsey ile konuşmalısınız.

entries.en: The keeper scan has been uploaded to the database.
You do not have the proper keycard.
Get to the Quarian and warn her before it's too late!
entries.tr: Çok geç olmadan Quarian'a ulaş ve onu uyar!

entries.en: Hello, Commander.
One sec, looking you up.
Commander Shepard, here with the Alliance Military. First time on the Citadel. That about right?
entries.tr: Komutan Shepard, İttifak Ordusu'ndan. Citadel'de ilk kez. Doğru mu?

entries.en: I'm the C-Sec requisitions officer. I need to make sure our buyers are authorized.
entries.tr: Ben C-Sec tedarik subayıyım. Alıcılarımızın yetkili olduğundan emin olmam gerek.

entries.en: Just checking for C-Sec records. I can only sell goods to authorized personnel.
entries.tr: Sadece C-Sec kayıtlarını kontrol ediyorum. Mallarımı yalnızca yetkili personele satabilirim.

entries.en: I'll open the rare stocks for you, Commander. Enjoy.
entries.tr: Nadir stokları sizin için açıyorum, Komutan. Keyfini çıkarın.

entries.en: Sounds good. Let me just set you up... whoa. This must be a mistake.
entries.tr: Güzel. Sizi ayarlayayım... vay. Bu bir hata olmalı.

entries.en: System's telling me to offer you our select stock... Spectre?
entries.tr: Sistem bana seçkin stoğumuzu sunmamı söylüyor... Spectre?

entries.en: Well... I'd heard about that, but I didn't realize it was you. Sorry, Commander.
entries.tr: Şey... Bunu duymuştum ama sizin olduğunuzu fark etmedim. Kusura bakmayın, Komutan.

entries.en: Excellent. I hope you find what you're looking for.
Sure thing, Commander. You have a good day, now.
How do you know who I am?
How did you know all that?
Who wants to know?
Show me what you've got.
Just show me what you've got.
I think I'll be going.
Goodbye.
You know me?
Sure is.
Why?
I need supplies.
Goodbye.
I'm done.
No problem.
Whatever.
So, will you be purchasing anything today, Commander Shepard?
entries.tr: Peki bugün bir şey satın alacak mısınız, Komutan Shepard?

entries.en: Maybe.
Why?
